description: This Java class defines the OrderAccount entity, including its properties, relationships, and basic getters/setters within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: OrderAccount
classes.description: Entity representing an order account, including dates, billing day, and associated products.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OrderAccount.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OrderAccount.

methods.name: getOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the account, cloned for safety.

methods.name: setOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the account, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the account, cloned for safety.

methods.name: setOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the account, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Returns the billing day of the account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Sets the billing day of the account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of associated OrderAccountProduct entities.
